learnings: Route `__init__` through the property setter so validation can't be bypassed.
Computed properties (`fahrenheit`) avoid storing the same fact twice.
`getattr`/`setattr` still trigger properties, so dynamic configuration stays validated.
pitfalls: The original `Person` accepted a negative age because the constructor wrote `_age` directly.
